variants.name: b4-verification
variants.description: Deterministic QA receipt for durable scoped skill governance, restart preservation, live run binding, origin, and deletion behavior

notes: Conversation, agent, and global precedence passed in both directions under server-full.
A real embedded run widened a global disable at conversation scope and retained its start-time binding across a mid-run disable; the next run did not activate.
Three child processes reopened one SurrealKV directory; builtin re-registration preserved global and per-agent disables, and the merge inversion failed before exact restoration.
API-created user deletion removed database and filesystem copies across another reopen, builtin deletion remained refused, and existing agent-binding replacement tests passed.
Tier 0 and strict OpenSpec validation passed; phase-level Tier 2 was not run.
